name: identify_color
description: Identify a color by hex code (e.g., "#FF5733"). Returns color name, RGB/HSL/HSV/CMYK values, and WCAG contrast ratios for accessibility.

hex.description: Hex color value without the # prefix (e.g. "FF5733").

name: generate_scheme
description: Generate harmonious color palettes from a seed hex color (e.g., "#3498DB"). Returns complementary, analogous, triadic, or monochromatic schemes with hex codes.

hex.description: Seed hex color value without the # prefix (e.g. "FF5733").

mode.description: Color scheme mode. One of: monochrome, analogic, complement, triad, quad. Defaults to "monochrome".

count.description: Number of colors to return (1-10, default 5).

name: convert_color
description: Convert between color formats: RGB to hex, HSL, HSV, CMYK. Returns the closest named color for the input values.
